    "func = _known_functions[func_name]()\n",
    "\n",
    "NSIDE = 2**7\n",
    "NPIX = hp.nside2npix(NSIDE)\n",
    "\n",
    "ra, dec  = hp.pix2ang(nside=NSIDE, ipix=np.arange(NPIX), lonlat=True)\n"
